answers.10_tests_prove_repair: Focused tests cover exact base key allow, runtime cron run key allow, malformed key hold, missing-anchor/no-reply hold, exact sanitized send authorize, sent receipt, duplicate block, and unbound NO_REPLY cancellation.
answers.1_component_owns_sanitized_reply_payload: Boundary handler before_agent_reply allow path owns producing reply.text from renderSanitized().
answers.2_component_owns_telegram_delivery_decis: Cron delivery runtime delivers announce output only when final payload text is non-silent and message_sending does not cancel it.
answers.3_data_shape_required_for_delivery: HookResult {handled:true, reply:{text:<sanitized non-NO_REPLY text>}} must produce payloads with text; then delivery runtime normalizes non-silent text and sends to announce target.
answers.4_m25g_lacked: M25G lacked handler allow because expectedSessionKey was cron:<jobId> but OpenClaw runtime hook ctx/session uses agent:<agent>:cron:<jobId>:run:<uuid>; handler returned HOLD_NO_DELIVERY without reply.
answers.5_handler_approved_but_no_payload_create: No; source contract and run result indicate a handled/no-reply HOLD path, not an approved reply payload.
answers.6_runner_never_create_reply_candidate: Runner would create a reply candidate from hookResult.reply.text; the repair ensures handler returns one on valid runtime cron key.
answers.7_announce_failed_to_imply_deliverable_p: Announce is not sufficient by itself; it cannot deliver exact NO_REPLY/silent payload.
answers.8_terminal_closeout_anchor_wrong_layer: Anchors were in caller payload; handler does not render them, but they were enough for caller-hash proof. Delivery success depends on handler allow reply.text.
answers.9_minimal_repair_point: Boundary handler session-key matcher and outbound message_sending scope must accept exact runtime cron run key shape for the exact configured job.

source_evidence.delivery_runtime_silent_contract: run-delivery.runtime normalizes exact NO_REPLY to no payload
source_evidence.handler_contract: evaluateBoundary READY returns reply.text; HOLD returns handled true without reply
source_evidence.runEmbeddedPiAgent_hook_payload_contract: pi-embedded: buildHandledReplyPayloads(hookResult.reply), final text NO_REPLY when reply missing
